title: A 2-Year-Old App Just Passed Etsy
source: Etsy Inc. 10-K filings, total marketplace Gross Merchandise Sales: 2019 $4.97B, 2020 $10.28B, 2021 $13.51B, 2022 $13.31B, 2023 $13.2B, 2024 $12.6B, 2025 $11.9B (three straight years of decline per Etsy's FY2025 10-K). TikTok Shop global Gross Merchandise Value, per company disclosures and reporting by Reuters/Momentum Works/Retail TouchPoints: an estimated $4.4B in its 2022 launch year, $11B in 2023, $33.2B in 2024, and $66B in 2025 (nearly doubling year over year). TikTok Shop's global GMV overtook Etsy's total GMS sometime in 2024, three years after TikTok Shop's first market launch.
